# robots.txt for the Sathi public website.
# Marketing pages (/, /about, /features, /blog, /contact, /login, /register) are crawlable.
# Authenticated app areas and the API are excluded.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /about
Allow: /features
Allow: /blog
Allow: /contact
Disallow: /youth
Disallow: /counselor
Disallow: /organization
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /notifications
Disallow: /api/

# The sitemap is generated by the API (static pages + published articles).
# Crawlers expect an absolute URL here: in production replace this relative path with
# your public host, e.g. "Sitemap: https://<your-domain>/api/v1/blog/sitemap.xml".
Sitemap: /api/v1/blog/sitemap.xml
